name: Manners
overview: Scripture teaches that manners, including respectful gestures and courteous behavior, are an important expression of godly character. Abraham and Lot exemplify obeisance to strangers by bowing and rising to meet them, demonstrating humility and honor toward guests (Genesis 18:2, 19:1). The aged and superiors are to be treated with reverence, as commanded in Leviticus 19:32 and shown by the respect given to the elderly in Job 29:8. Additionally, standing while guests eat and observing proper conduct in the presence of others reflect a heart of courtesy rooted in the fear of the Lord (Genesis 18:8, 31:35).
